description: Issue one current Oracle Watch halt/proceed signal inside an open monitored window purchased with oracle_watch_window_begin. Covered by the window purchase — no per-call charge — but counted against the window poll budget (300 per 24h, minimum 30s apart). Authenticates with the one-time window token from the purchase; without it the call fails closed.

windowToken.description: The one-time token returned at purchase (oww_<hex>)

name: oracle_watch_window_poll
